title: UpliftBench: Revealing Outcome-Regime and Objective Mismatch in Uplift Evaluation
description: Code, configs, data loaders, and results for the UpliftBench paper. Evaluates 12 uplift estimators on 25 datasets spanning synthetic, semi-synthetic (IHDP, Jobs), and real-world marketing RCT settings (Hillstrom, Lenta, X5, MegaFon). Outer-test-isolated protocol with nested CV tuning. Released under MIT license.
